why: An independent CLAIM REVIEW ran on the preregistration. It returned VERDICT NO -- not fit to be measured against -- on two blockers, and landed ten further findings. This amendment records what it broke and what the corrections are. It is written BEFORE the post-change numbers are taken. The code change itself was already written when the review returned; the review attacked the CLAIMS, and every claim it moved is moved here rather than after the measurement.

F1.finding: the preregistration says the ahtu/ahtv w-point average 'carries the stage's Kmm'. It does not: ahtu/ahtv carry no time index at all (traldf_iso.F90:291-294). Only akz's e3w does (:325,:330), and akz is dead on this card (ln_traldf_msc = F).
F1.label: NOT-A-DEFECT in the change, WRONG SENTENCE
F1.disposition: the sentence is corrected here and in the receipt. The rest of the NEMO reading was independently verified, including that grep for ldf_slp/zdf_mxl/zdf_phy in stprk3_stg.F90 returns ZERO hits, so nothing recomputes the slopes between stages, and that nmln/hmlp are module globals set by zdf_phy(kstp,Nbb,Nbb,Nrhs) at stprk3.F90:165 -- also before-level.

F2.finding: BLOCKER. PR1 and PR4 are bounded by the WRONG ARM. Round 38's substitution set K := NEMO's own zwt_mix, which removes the fold AND the legoESM-vs-NEMO avt difference. This change removes only the fold. Round 38 measured that avt difference at 1.73472e-18, and round 38's own claim review measured that perturbing every wet avt by one ulp moves T by up to 1.16e-14 K. So the sound ceiling is 1.421e-14 + 1.16e-14 ~ 2.6e-14 K, not 1.43e-14: PR1's falsifier would fire on a change that is exactly correct.
F2.label: BLOCKER
F2.disposition: PR1 and PR4 are REPLACED below, and the missing arm is added to the gate: substitute legoESM's OWN captured K with its OWN fold subtracted back out (the gate already computes that array at :541 for the attribution and never fed it to the residual). That arm runs on the PRE-change model and PREDICTS the post-change number.

F3.finding: the GM/Redi tracer TENDENCY is causally dead on this lane -- dT_gm reaches only T_mid, the _ab2_advective branch is unreachable on a forward-Euler card, the rk3_ws tracer base is state.T.data, and T_mid has no consumer after the tracer program. The one escape, the through-FCT bolus, is closed because the card resolves gm_bolus_advection = 'centred' (instantiated, Rule 10).
F3.label: NOT-A-DEFECT, and it is the linchpin
F3.disposition: independently CONFIRMED by measurement before the review returned: zeroing gm_redi_tracer_tendency_latlon's whole output moves GYRE's kt=1 T by 0 of 21120 bits, while zeroing K33 moves it by 3.196021e-11 K on 7045 cells. Both recorded as measurements.

F4.finding: that same deadness is an UNDISCHARGED RULE-12 OBLIGATION the preregistration omits: the change moves the operands of gm_redi_tracer_tendency_latlon on a lane where its output is discarded, so that leg is unmeasurable on all three cards.
F4.label: REAL
F4.disposition: REGISTERED as debt with an owner and a boundary, not claimed. PR2 is restated as covering the K33 leg only.

F5.finding: BLOCKER. GMRediConfig.slope_prd_geometry_stage='before_step' already routes the slope density's tracers and Jacobian to the step-entry state on a forward-Euler card (:7185-7207), and GYRE resolves 'current_step'. The preregistration never mentions it, so the change would land a second mechanism for part of the same move and leave a knob whose default keeps the bug.
F5.label: BLOCKER
F5.disposition: MEASURED, not argued: the card is built twice, once with slope_prd_geometry_stage='before_step' and once with the default, and the step's T and S are compared bit for bit AFTER the change. The two paths are claimed REDUNDANT, not conflicting -- the knob overrides only native_prd_TS/native_prd_jacobian, which on this lane become the same arrays the change now passes positionally -- and the measurement is what decides it. The knob is NOT the ship vehicle: a knob whose default preserves the old behaviour is exactly what the campaign forbids, so the placement is unconditional on the lane that runs NEMO's stage program.

F6.finding: a FOURTH configuration executes the changed lines and is unlisted: fidelity/nemo_recipe.py:926 build_nemo_gyre_recipe resolves gm_redi with kappa_Redi = 1000 and rk3_ws on both integrators. It has no trajectory gate, but committed tests build it, and tests/ocean/unit/test_gm_bolus_through_fct.py:38 selects gm_bolus_advection='through_fct', where F3's deadness does NOT hold.
F6.label: REAL
F6.disposition: given UNMEASURED-WITH-SPEC treatment, and the expectation is stated HERE, before the run: on a through-FCT card the bolus transport DOES reach the tracer flux, so that card's numbers MAY move; a test asserting an invariant should still pass and a test asserting a golden number may not. Whatever happens is reported as a moved row with its boundary.

F7.finding: PR5 is verified on BOTH sides. The tanks resolve gm_redi = None (nemo_testcase_recipe.py:330, whole_step_identity='lane1_flux_up3' at :616,:704), so the whole GM block is skipped and _T_gm_in is a dead assignment; and NEMO agrees, ln_traldf_OFF = T and ln_traldf_iso = F (lock_kt1_10/ocean.output:578,584 and overflow_kt1_10/ocean.output:690,696), so l_ldfslp = F and ldf_slp is never called there.
F7.label: NOT-A-DEFECT
F7.disposition: PR5 stands as written, now with both citations. The trajectories are still MEASURED.

F8.finding: PR3's band is unfalsifiable: it claims <= 1.8e-18 and its falsifier fires above 1e-17, so a measured 5e-18 violates the claim and satisfies nothing.
F8.label: REAL

F9.finding: PR2's exact zero IS reachable -- nemo_native takes nemo_iso_a33 with msc=False, no floor, no epsilon, no DM95 taper, and NEMO's own zeps is a denominator so a zero numerator stays exactly zero -- but the claim is kt=1-ONLY: it holds because the before-state density is exactly horizontally uniform with eta identically 0.
F9.label: MINOR

F10.finding: M3's reading is a RESIDUAL BUCKET (skill Rule 5). eta alone moves K33 by +0.004 per cent, yet the table credits it with 1.35 per cent. And 'BOTH gives EXACTLY 0.0 bit for bit' is an exact claim from an instrument whose own control reproduces the live value only to 4.3e-10.
F10.label: MINOR and correct
F10.disposition: reworded: the TRACER time level removes 98.65 per cent; the remaining 1.35 per cent vanishes only when eta moves too, so the two are NOT separable and neither is 'the owner' of that remainder. The zero is stated as 'exactly 0.0 on this instrument', and PR2 measures it IN-GRAPH through the operand gate, which is bit-exact.

F11.finding: unlisted movers: native_bolus_slope_eta stays on the after-ssh, and the change deletes the autodiff path from GM/Redi through the forward-Euler predictor.
F11.label: MINOR
F11.disposition: both named. native_bolus_slope_eta is deliberately UNMOVED -- NEMO's ldf_eiv_trp precedes dynamics and the existing comment records that placement, and moving it is a separate statement with its own arm. The gradient path is inert on these three cards because the tendency's output is discarded (F3).

F12.finding: the direct test is blind to the other branch: it pins _T_gm_in on the rk3_ws lane and says nothing about _ldf_state taking precedence, so the modified-leapfrog lane could regress silently.
F12.label: MINOR
F12.disposition: a test is added that _ldf_state still wins when supplied.

PR1.claim: GYRE kt=1 stage-3 T residual falls from 3.1956659540810506e-11 K to (a) <= 2.6e-14 K, the sum of round 38's substitution figure 1.4210854715202004e-14 and its claim review's measured one-ulp-avt bound 1.16e-14, AND (b) the value the new lego_avt_no_fold arm measures on the PRE-change model, to within that arm's own substitution noise.
PR1.falsifier: the residual exceeds 2.6e-14 K, or disagrees with the lego_avt_no_fold arm by more than 1e-15 K.

PR2.claim: operand.K33_fold goes from 17400/17400 wet faces unequal at 9.66209e-13 to 0/17400 at absolute maximum 0.0, EXACT, measured IN-GRAPH by the operand gate. This covers the K33 leg only, and it is a kt=1 claim: it holds because GYRE's before-state density is exactly horizontally uniform with eta identically 0.

PR3.claim: operand.K goes from 17383/17400 at 9.66209e-13 to an absolute maximum <= 1.8e-18, not to 0; the remainder is the closure's own avt difference and is a different owner.

PR4.claim: GYRE kt=1 stage-3 S residual falls from 8.1712414612411521e-13 psu to the value the lego_avt_no_fold arm measures, and NO ceiling is asserted for it: the S-side one-ulp-avt bound is UNMEASURED, so asserting round 38's 2.8421709430404007e-14 would be the same defect F2 named on the T side.
PR4.falsifier: it disagrees with the lego_avt_no_fold arm by more than 1e-15 psu.

PR5.claim: unchanged, and now double-sourced: the tanks resolve gm_redi = None and NEMO resolves ln_traldf_iso = F on both, so the changed lines never execute and both kt=1..10 trajectories are BIT-IDENTICAL before and after.
PR5.falsifier: any scored row of either tank moves.

PR7.claim: unchanged -- NO VALUE is predicted for the kt=2 given-inputs row.
PR7.falsifier: none; it is an arm with a bar.

PR8.claim: ORCA2 stays UNMEASURED-WITH-SPEC; and the FOURTH configuration F6 names, build_nemo_gyre_recipe, joins it with the expectation written above.

PR9.claim: NEW, from F5. With the change in place, building the card with slope_prd_geometry_stage='before_step' gives T and S BIT-IDENTICAL to the default 'current_step' on GYRE's kt=1 step -- the two mechanisms are redundant on this lane, not competing.
PR9.falsifier: any bit differs, which would mean the change and the knob disagree about what the before state is, and the disposition of the knob becomes a blocker rather than a note.
